packageRules.description: Our own Dockerfiles pin base images by digest.
A followed branch moves with every upstream push; bump it once a week, not on every commit.

OpenMuse's three images share one upstream commit, so they move in one pull request. Their base images ride in the same pull request, on the same weekly schedule: a base image change alone keeps the tag the same, so CI fails until someone bumps revision:. Next to a commit move, the tag changes on its own.
OSIRIS: one image, its own upstream commit, weekly schedule.
opendray: one image, its own upstream commit, weekly schedule.

customManagers.description: An image that follows an upstream branch: bump the pinned commit when the branch moves.
An image that follows upstream releases: bump the tag and its commit together.
